comment: A RECORDED run, not a CI gate: mutating the tree and running every layer takes minutes and cannot be part of the per-commit gates. What IS gated is the campaign DEFINITION (every anchor still resolves) and this file's internal consistency — see tests/test_generated_docs.py.

mutations.what: harness-honesty control: no mutation at all, which must report zero failing layers
mutations.rule: campaign hygiene

mutations.what: the reference's canonical form stops sorting keys
mutations.rule: canonical: keys sorted by code point

mutations.what: the reference's canonical form escapes non-ASCII instead of emitting it raw
mutations.rule: canonical: every code point outside the C0 rule is raw

mutations.what: the reference's canonical form re-introduces insignificant whitespace
mutations.rule: canonical: no insignificant whitespace

mutations.what: the reference stops refusing the literal -0
mutations.rule: canonical domain: -0 is where the two parsers disagree about what parsing means

mutations.what: the reference stops bounding integer literals to signed 64 bits
mutations.rule: canonical domain: integers lie in [-2**63, 2**63-1]

mutations.what: the reference accepts a float literal instead of refusing it
mutations.rule: canonical domain: the OwnIR vocabulary has no float

mutations.what: the reference accepts NaN/Infinity, which serde_json rejects as invalid JSON
mutations.rule: canonical domain: both engines must agree the document parses at all

mutations.what: the reference's VALUE-level domain backstop stops refusing a float
mutations.rule: canonical domain: enforced at the value level too, for an already-parsed document

mutations.what: the reference's verification stops comparing the recomputed hash
mutations.rule: artifact: the digest is a gate, recomputed from the embedded document

mutations.what: the reference stops lifting a layer refusal into the envelope's status
mutations.rule: artifact: one layer envelope, status produced|refused

mutations.what: the reference stops lifting surface_version into the layer envelope
mutations.rule: artifact: a refused layer still names the surface it refused on

mutations.what: the reference stops carrying the document's own declared schema version
mutations.rule: artifact: input.ownir_version is the document's declared version, verbatim

mutations.what: the reference reorders the frozen layer vocabulary
mutations.rule: artifact: layers are an ORDERED array in pipeline order

mutations.what: the reference's verification stops checking the frozen engine order
mutations.rule: artifact: engines are an ORDERED array over the frozen vocabulary

mutations.what: the reference renders the artifact with a different indent
mutations.rule: artifact rendering: 2-space indent, byte-identical on re-run

mutations.what: the port's canonical form stops sorting object keys
mutations.rule: canonical: keys sorted by code point

mutations.what: the port escapes U+007F, which the reference emits raw
mutations.rule: canonical escape rule: U+007F is NOT escaped

mutations.what: the port escapes control code points with uppercase hex
mutations.rule: canonical escape rule: \u00xx with LOWERCASE hex

mutations.what: the port renders the artifact with a different indent width
mutations.rule: artifact rendering: 2-space indent, byte-for-byte with the reference

mutations.what: the port renders an artifact's objects in sorted rather than document order
mutations.rule: artifact rendering keeps DOCUMENT order while the hash sorts — two serializations, two jobs

mutations.what: the port resolves a duplicate key first-wins instead of last-wins
mutations.rule: canonical: the parsed document is what CPython's dict would hold

mutations.what: the port wraps an out-of-i64 integer instead of refusing it
mutations.rule: canonical domain: integers lie in [-2**63, 2**63-1]

mutations.what: the port accepts a float as an integer instead of refusing it
mutations.rule: canonical domain: the OwnIR vocabulary has no float

mutations.what: the port's verification stops comparing the recomputed digest
mutations.rule: artifact: the digest is a gate, recomputed from the embedded document

mutations.what: the port's verification stops checking the frozen layer order
mutations.rule: artifact: every engine reports exactly the frozen layers, in that order

mutations.what: the port's verification stops checking the frozen engine order
mutations.rule: artifact: engines are an ORDERED array over the frozen vocabulary

mutations.what: the port renders the digest with uppercase hex
mutations.rule: canonical hash: SHA-256, LOWERCASE hex

mutations.what: the port hashes the RENDERING form instead of the canonical form
mutations.rule: canonical: the hash is taken over the canonical bytes, not over the artifact's rendering

mutations.what: the port reorders the frozen layer vocabulary
mutations.rule: artifact: layers are an ORDERED array in pipeline order

mutations.what: the port's `has` stops distinguishing a present member from an absent one
mutations.rule: artifact: document present exactly when produced, error exactly when refused
